items.title: Nuxt Unleashed
items.subtitle: Harnessing the Power of Nuxt 3
items.description: Nuxt Unleashed is a comprehensive guide to building modern web applications with Nuxt 3. From server-side rendering to static site generation, this book covers everything you need to know to harness the full power of the Nuxt framework. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced developer, you'll find practical examples, best practices, and real-world patterns to take your Nuxt applications to the next level.
toc: Chapter 8: API Routes and Server Middleware
